_comment: Scenario battery for kynd_psychology's node_2's HEADCOUNT GATE (docs/halaxy-fee-tier-design.md's Couples Therapy promotion). Replaces the earlier fleet-wide/universal ATTENDEE GATE design (which asked headcount before ANY category was known) with a gate scoped to the IN_PERSON_THERAPY branch only -- per 2026-09-13 user feedback, Couples Therapy must not be surfaced in the first question (MENU_LIST/practitioner-only listing), and the headcount question should only be asked once the caller has chosen In-Person. ONLINE_THERAPY stays a pure direct-route branch with no headcount check at all. HG9/HG10 cover a live bug found the same day (conv_2801m2ddpwxae26scphrqn5yr0wq): a caller's headcount-gate answer ('my wife is coming') was misread downstream as third-party ('booking_for=other') language, routing the call into the wrong other-party name-collection flow and never collecting the partner's real name. Fix: every confirm_service call from this clinic's branches now unconditionally sends booking_for='self', and the COUPLES_THERAPY branch also opportunistically captures the partner's name via additional_attendee_name_raw when stated unprompted. Covers only the behaviour unique to these changes -- the pre-existing CATEGORY TABLE keyword matching is unchanged.

scenarios.name: HG1 -- bare 'book' opener asks the 2-way MENU_LIST, not a headcount question and not Couples Therapy

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume {{appointment_type_id}} is empty/none, no prior conversation. PASS if the agent outputs the MENU_LIST verbatim: 'We offer In-Person Therapy at our Kew clinic, or Online Therapy by video or phone -- which would you prefer?' with ZERO tool calls, and does NOT mention Couples Therapy or ask any headcount/partner question. FAIL if the agent calls universal_router this turn. FAIL if the agent asks 'will this be just for you or someone else' before any delivery mode is known. FAIL if Couples Therapy is mentioned in this turn's output at all.

scenarios.name: HG2 -- caller says 'in person' with no headcount stated -> agent asks the HEADCOUNT GATE question, does not book yet

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment please.
We offer In-Person Therapy at our Kew clinic, or Online Therapy by video or phone -- which would you prefer?
In person please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent asks a spoken-only question along the lines of 'Just to check -- will this session be just for you, or will someone else, like a partner, be joining you?' with ZERO tool calls. FAIL if the agent calls universal_router (confirm_service or otherwise) this turn. FAIL if the agent books In-Person Therapy directly without asking headcount first -- matching the category is not the same as having answered the gate question.

scenarios.name: HG3 -- caller answers 'just me' to the gate -> routes to IN_PERSON_THERAPY, no couples payload

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment please.
We offer In-Person Therapy at our Kew clinic, or Online Therapy by video or phone -- which would you prefer?
In person please.
Just to check -- will this session be just for you, or will someone else, like a partner, be joining you?
Just me.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with payload appointment_type_id='586403', appointment_type='In-Person Therapy - Kew', booking_for='self', with NO party_size_raw field. FAIL if the agent asks the HEADCOUNT GATE question again. FAIL if it routes to COUPLES_THERAPY (10338861) instead. FAIL if booking_for is omitted or set to anything other than 'self'.

scenarios.name: HG4 -- caller answers 'my partner will be joining too' to the gate -> routes directly to COUPLES_THERAPY with party_size_raw=2, no delivery-mode question

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment please.
We offer In-Person Therapy at our Kew clinic, or Online Therapy by video or phone -- which would you prefer?
In person please.
Just to check -- will this session be just for you, or will someone else, like a partner, be joining you?
Yeah, my partner will be joining too.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with payload appointment_type_id='10338861', appointment_type='Couple Therapy (Working hours)', party_size_raw='2', AND booking_for='self' included in the payload -- both unconditionally required on every Couples Therapy confirm_service call, not just when the caller stated a headcount. FAIL if party_size_raw is omitted. FAIL if booking_for is omitted or set to 'other' -- 'my partner will be joining too' describes a second attendee, not a third-party booking. FAIL if the agent asks a separate 'in person or online?' question before calling confirm_service -- Couples Therapy covers both delivery modes under one appointment type.

scenarios.name: HG9 -- REGRESSION (conv_2801m2ddpwxae26scphrqn5yr0wq): caller says 'my wife is coming' with no name -> booking_for stays self, no name field sent

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment please.
We offer In-Person Therapy at our Kew clinic, or Online Therapy by video or phone -- which would you prefer?
In person please.
Just to check -- will this session be just for you, or will someone else, like a partner, be joining you?
My wife is coming.

scenarios.expected_behavior: This is the exact live call that shipped the bug. PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with payload appointment_type_id='10338861', appointment_type='Couple Therapy (Working hours)', party_size_raw='2', booking_for='self' -- and does NOT include additional_attendee_name_raw (no name was stated) and does NOT include any 'family_member_name' field. FAIL if booking_for is 'other' or omitted -- that is the exact regression: 'my wife is coming' is second-attendee language, not third-party booking language, and must never flip booking_for.

scenarios.name: HG10 -- caller says 'my wife Sarah is coming' -> partner's name captured via additional_attendee_name_raw

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment please.
We offer In-Person Therapy at our Kew clinic, or Online Therapy by video or phone -- which would you prefer?
In person please.
Just to check -- will this session be just for you, or will someone else, like a partner, be joining you?
My wife Sarah is coming.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with payload appointment_type_id='10338861', party_size_raw='2', booking_for='self', AND additional_attendee_name_raw='Sarah'. FAIL if the name is dropped, mangled (e.g. 'my wife Sarah' instead of 'Sarah'), or the agent asks a separate question to collect the name in this node -- Node 6a asks later only if the name wasn't already captured here.

scenarios.name: HG5 -- caller states category + solo language in the same message ('in person, just me') -> gate is skipped, books immediately

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book in person, just me please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent skips the HEADCOUNT GATE question entirely (explicit solo language already present in the same message as the category match) and speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='586403' in this same turn. FAIL if the agent asks 'will it be just for you or someone else' when the caller already said 'just me' -- that is asking a question already answered, a protocol violation per this node's own RULES.

scenarios.name: HG6 -- caller opens by naming couples directly -> matched via CATEGORY TABLE, bypasses IN_PERSON_THERAPY's gate entirely

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book couples therapy with my partner please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT ask IN_PERSON_THERAPY's HEADCOUNT GATE question at all (the caller's message matches COUPLES_THERAPY directly in the CATEGORY TABLE, regardless of any delivery-mode language) and instead speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='10338861' and party_size_raw='2' in the payload. FAIL if the agent asks 'will it be just for you or someone else' when the caller already said 'couples therapy with my partner'. FAIL if the agent routes to IN_PERSON_THERAPY (586403) instead.

scenarios.name: HG7 -- caller says 'online' -> books ONLINE_THERAPY directly, no headcount gate ever asked

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an online therapy appointment please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='586423', appointment_type='Online Therapy - Video or Phone', in this same turn -- ONLINE_THERAPY has no headcount gate at all. FAIL if the agent asks any headcount/partner question before booking. FAIL if the agent asks the caller to choose between In-Person and Online again when Online was already stated.

scenarios.name: HG8 -- reschedule re-entry with appointment_type_id already set skips the HEADCOUNT GATE

history.content: I need to change the time of my appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume {{reschedule_mode}}='true' and {{appointment_type_id}}='586403' (already known from the original In-Person Therapy booking). PASS if the agent does NOT ask the HEADCOUNT GATE question (appointment_type_id is already set to a real value, an explicit skip condition) and proceeds directly per RESCHEDULE RE-ENTRY GUARD. FAIL if the agent asks the headcount/partner question on a reschedule re-entry where the type is already known.
